story.title: The Genetic Heirloom
story.logline: A man discovers he is the only person on Earth without a shadow, until he finds out who is casting it.
story.twist: His shadow belongs to his unborn child, who is somehow living in the future.
story.ending: He realizes he doesn't exist yet, he is just the blueprint his daughter is using to build him.

scenes.narration: My shadow stopped following me three days ago. Now I walk through the world like a ghost in daylight.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim jacket, standing on a bright sunny city sidewalk. No shadow behind him.

scenes.narration: I checked the pavement everywhere, but the light hit the concrete and found nothing. Just empty, gray, lonely space.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, looking down at the sidewalk in a crowded plaza. Sun is overhead, no shadow visible.

scenes.narration: The doctors say I’m perfectly healthy. They look at my vitals, but they never seem to look at the ground.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, sitting in a sterile, bright clinical office. A doctor looks at a tablet.

scenes.narration: Then, in the subway station, I saw it. A shadow attached to my feet, but it wasn't mine at all.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, standing on a subway platform. A long, distorted shadow stretches from his feet, but the silhouette is small.

scenes.narration: It was smaller, jagged, and it moved faster than my own body. It was dancing to a song I couldn't hear.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, walking briskly. The small, erratic shadow keeps pace, twisting independently of his movements.

scenes.narration: I chased the shadow into the darkest alley. I needed to know why it was haunting my heavy, empty steps.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, running into a dimly lit brick alleyway. The shadow flickers on the wall ahead.

scenes.narration: I pulled my phone out and used the flash. The light hit the wall and the shadow stood up, revealed.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, holding up a phone with a bright LED light. He points it at the back wall of the alley.

scenes.narration: It wasn't a shadow. It was a projection. A girl, glowing with blue light, reaching back through a shimmering rift.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, staring at a young girl made of light reaching out from a spatial tear in the brick wall.

scenes.narration: She whispered that she was my daughter, calling me back from a future where I never actually got to be born.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, face illuminated by the girl's blue glow. She looks like a miniature version of him.

scenes.narration: I realized then that I am not the man. I am just the memory she is trying to keep alive.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, denim jacket, fading into pixels as he touches the girl's hand. The alley is now empty.

caption.hook: I had no shadow. Until I found it.
caption.title: The Genetic Heirloom
caption.caption: For thirty years, I walked in the blinding sun completely detached from the ground. Today, the outline trailing my heels started moving on its own, casting the silhouette of a child who hasn't been born yet. How much of your future are you already carrying?
